A Message from Your Host

We hope you enjoy your stay at this stunning 5-bedroom home in Mission Hills! With panoramic views of the San Diego Bay and city skyline, multiple outdoor decks, and an open-concept layout, this home is the perfect base for exploring everything San Diego has to offer.

How to Enter
Entering Jackson Street
  1. Your door access code will be sent via Airbnb message on the day of check-in.
  2. Locate the digital keypad at the private entrance.
  3. Enter your 4-digit code — the lock will beep and unlock when accepted.
  4. Contact the host immediately if you have any trouble.
Private entrance — 2525 Jackson St
Section
Parking
Parking at Jackson Street
  • Free off-street parking available at the property.
  • Park fully on-site without blocking the street or sidewalk.
  • Street parking on Jackson St and surrounding Mission Hills streets typically plentiful.

House Rules
General Rules
  • Max occupancy: 16 guests.
  • No smoking anywhere on the property, indoors or outdoors.
  • Pets welcome — clean up after your pet, keep off furniture.
  • No parties without host approval.
  • Quiet hours: 10 PM – 8 AM (sound carries with open bay views).
Outdoor Decks & Fire Pit
  • No glass near the fire pit — use the cups provided.
  • Ensure the fire pit is fully extinguished before going inside for the night.
  • Be especially mindful of noise on decks after 10 PM.
  • Do not lean on or climb deck railings.

Check-Out
Before You Go
  1. Strip all beds — leave used linens on the floor.
  2. Wash all dishes and return to cabinets.
  3. Take all trash to the bins outside.
  4. Empty the refrigerator of perishables.
  5. Turn off all lights, fans, electronics.
  6. Ensure fire pit is fully extinguished.
  7. Close the BBQ lid.
  8. Lock all doors and windows.
  9. Message the host to confirm check-out.

Check-out time: 11:00 AM.
